{{Top|leg}}
A '''trico filter''' was a [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing apparatus]] created by the [[Melodie]]s of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]. It was constructed by sewing the stems of the [[trico]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] into a pocket, then filling it with a blue-green [[Algae/Legends|algae]]. The trico acted as a [[Water/Legends|water]] repellent, and the Melodies tied the filter over their nose and mouth. The algae produced enough [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] to allow the younger Melodies to breath underwater.<ref name="Lyric">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World]]''</ref>
